summary: Replace #710's A+C battle court rails with Mendon's placard layout: clickable Province Strength placards on defending provinces, a fixed left-edge stack (opponent, Province, own) on the clan placard frame, and an engine-computed ProvinceFalls flag driving the Province Destroyed katana. Rails code and art removed; review fixtures add Light Armor on/off.
validation: dotnet run battle-values 7/7; native check-battle-values-ui equivalent (BATTLE_VALUES_PASS: eight scenarios, both seats, stack/katana/click/frame clearance, Light Armor toggle) on Windows; full tools/check.sh --skip-client result recorded in the PR
remaining: Windows graphical playability review and Mac preview not done; maneuver-phase placards share the battle code path but only engaged scenes were captured; 'active player' read as the viewing player.
